'''Whole blue milk''' was a way of serving [[Blue milk/Legends|blue milk]]. Whole blue-milk was served in [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in either small portions for 1.5 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] or in large portions for 2.3 credits.
